analysis:
Speaking to Indian Foreign Service probationers on 11 June 2008, Manmohan Singh said India would not sign the CTBT because it would prevent further nuclear tests and impinge on sovereignty, according to press reports.

India has not signed the treaty. The Arms Control Association's status table, last reviewed in July 2024, lists India, Pakistan and North Korea as the three Annex 2 states that have not signed.

The statement therefore held. India has maintained a voluntary moratorium on nuclear testing without joining the treaty.
notes: The quote is the reported wording. The Arms Control Association status table was last reviewed in July 2024 and lists India as not having signed.
